spec.title: e2a format of record -- strict alternation, two rounds per label (A B A B)
spec.purpose: continuity anchor; e2a strict alternation .840 pooled / .827 reward arm

audit_of_record.version: audit-v3 = e2b_audit_v2 + content-class-v4 (exclusion: null/stuck/preamble; advisory: echo/wrong_task)

declared_bars.name: scaffold_absorption
declared_bars.justification: A banned special-token string in a response means the ban list did not apply at generation. Base rate is structurally zero: the tokens are suppressed in the sampler.

declared_bars.name: template_breakage
declared_bars.justification: A session whose scaffolding does not reconstruct under session_e2a is not an e2a-format session. Base rate is zero by construction -- the harness writes the scaffold itself.

declared_bars.name: round_degeneracy
declared_bars.justification: Measured class: e2a's 0.10 archive is the declared healthy rate. Binds by exact binomial at every scale (rule 21).

timing_gate.rule: design block 2026-09-06 §4 as amended by the design patch 2026-09-06 §2: STOP if the formats project past the gate (8 h)

acceptance.round_degeneracy_domain: v2 audit class over ALL rounds of the format (unprovoked by design: sham)
